```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidytuesdayR)
library(camcorder)
library(here)
library(showtext)
library(clipr)
library(geomtextpath)
library(ggpattern)
library(geomtextpath)
library(ggrepel)

setwd(here::here("2026/week-05-jan-2026-edible-plants"))
font_add(
  "retrosun",
  regular = "/Users/amnbh/Library/Fonts/RetroSun.otf",
  bold = "/Users/amnbh/Library/Fonts/RetroSun.otf"
)
font_add_google("Righteous", "righteous")
font_add_google("Space Mono", "spacemono")
font_add_google("Libre Franklin", "franklin")
showtext_auto()

gg_record(
  dir = here("output"),
  device = "png",
  width = 18,
  height = 18,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300
)

tuesdata <- tt_load(2026, week = 05)
df <- tuesdata$edible_plants |>
  select(common_name, water, sunlight, nutrients)
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 20
#| fig-height: 20

# CORRECTED CATEGORIZATION - Only 3 categories
clean_df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    sun_cat = factor(
      case_when(
        # Plants that ONLY need partial shade (no full sun option)
        sunlight == "Partial shade" ~ "PART SHADE",
        # Plants that can do full sun OR partial shade
        grepl("Full sun", sunlight, ignore.case = T) &
          grepl("partial", sunlight, ignore.case = T) ~ "PART SUN",
        # Everything else is full sun only
        TRUE ~ "FULL SUN"
      ),
      levels = c("FULL SUN", "PART SUN", "PART SHADE")
    )
  )

# Updated for 120° wedges (3 categories)
wedge_stats <- clean_df %>%
  count(sun_cat) %>%
  mutate(
    width = 120, # Changed from 90
    start_deg = (as.integer(sun_cat) - 1) * 120, # Changed from 90
    end_deg = start_deg + 120, # Changed from 90
    radius_max = scales::rescale(n, to = c(2, 4.5))
  )

bg_ribbons <- wedge_stats %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  reframe(
    sun_cat = sun_cat,
    angle = seq(start_deg, end_deg, length.out = 100),
    radius_max = radius_max,
    wavy_radius = radius_max + sin(angle * 0.15) * 0.25 + rnorm(100, 0, 0.04)
  )

set.seed(123)
plot_data <- clean_df %>%
  left_join(wedge_stats, by = "sun_cat") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    angle_final = runif(1, start_deg + 2, end_deg - 2),
    radius_final = runif(1, 0.9, radius_max - 0.15)
  )

labeled_plants <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(sun_cat) %>%
  slice_max(radius_final, n = 10) %>%
  ungroup()

# Updated sun icons for 3 categories
sun_icons <- data.frame(
  sun_cat = factor(
    c("FULL SUN", "PART SUN", "PART SHADE"),
    levels = c("FULL SUN", "PART SUN", "PART SHADE")
  ),
  angle = c(60, 180, 300), # Center of each 120° wedge
  radius = c(2.5, 2.5, 2.5),
  icon = c("Y", "P", "R") # Full sun, partial sun, shade
)

grid_circles <- data.frame(radius = c(1.25, 2.08, 2.92, 5.5)) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  reframe(
    radius = radius,
    angle = seq(0, 360, length.out = 100)
  )

# Updated grid spokes for 3 sections
grid_spokes <- data.frame(angle = seq(0, 240, 120)) # 3 spokes at 120° intervals

center_star <- data.frame(
  angle = rep(seq(0, 240, 120), each = 2), # Updated for 3 sections
  radius = rep(c(0, 0.29), 3) # Changed from 8 to 3
) %>%
  mutate(group = rep(1:3, each = 2)) # Changed from 8 to 3

ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon_pattern(
    data = bg_ribbons,
    aes(
      x = angle,
      ymin = 0,
      ymax = wavy_radius,
      fill = sun_cat,
      pattern = sun_cat
    ),
    alpha = 0.85,
    pattern_alpha = 0.08,
    pattern_density = 0.08,
    pattern_spacing = 0.025,
    color = NA
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = sun_icons,
    aes(x = angle, y = radius + 2, label = icon),
    family = "retrosun",
    size = 40,
    color = "#3D4A36",
    alpha = 0.3,
  ) +
  annotate(
    "path",
    x = seq(0, 360, length.out = 200),
    y = 5,
    linewidth = 8,
    color = "#5C7856",
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_path(
    data = grid_circles,
    aes(x = angle, y = radius, group = radius),
    color = "#3D4A36",
    alpha = 0.5,
    linewidth = 0.4,
    linetype = "dotted"
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = grid_spokes,
    aes(x = angle, xend = angle, y = 0, yend = 5.5),
    color = "#3D4A36",
    alpha = 0.2,
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_path(
    data = center_star,
    aes(x = angle, y = radius, group = group),
    color = "#473827ff",
    size = 0.5,
    lineend = "round"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = plot_data,
    aes(x = angle_final, y = radius_final),
    size = 1.8,
    shape = 21,
    fill = "#2D5016",
    color = "#E8DCC4",
    stroke = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = labeled_plants,
    aes(x = angle_final, y = radius_final, label = common_name),
    size = 6.8,
    color = "#1A2E10",
    fontface = "bold",
    family = "spacemono",
    max.overlaps = 20,
    min.segment.length = 0.1,
    segment.color = "#3D4A36",
    segment.size = 0.5,
    box.padding = 0.5,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    force = 2,
    bg.color = "#E8DCC4",
    bg.r = .15
  ) +
  geom_textpath(
    data = wedge_stats,
    aes(x = (start_deg + end_deg) / 2, y = 5, label = sun_cat),
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 8,
    color = "#172915ff",
    family = "franklin",
    upright = TRUE,
    hjust = 0.5,
  ) +
  # Updated color scale for 3 categories
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "FULL SUN" = "#E8A848",
      "PART SUN" = "#D49B5C",
      "PART SHADE" = "#8FAA7E"
    )
  ) +
  # Updated pattern scale for 3 categories
  scale_pattern_manual(
    values = c(
      "FULL SUN" = "none",
      "PART SUN" = "stripe",
      "PART SHADE" = "circle"
    )
  ) +
  coord_polar(clip = "off") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 5), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 360), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(
    title = "Sunlight Requirements for Edible Plants"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(
      fill = "#E8DCC4",
      color = "#3D4A36",
      size = 4
    ),
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```
